d: What are allotropes of carbon? In this video, we explain allotropy in simple words using the Lego brick analogy — same building blocks, completely different structures. Learn why diamond is the hardest material on Earth while graphite (pencil lead) breaks so easily, even though both are made entirely of carbon atoms. We cover diamond, graphite, buckminsterfullerene (buckyballs), carbon nanotubes, amorphous carbon, and lonsdaleite (hexagonal diamond formed during meteorite impacts).
